forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {叶|かな}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to fulfill; to grant; to make come true
definitions.explanation: To make a wish, dream, or hope become reality. Can describe both fulfilling one's own dreams and granting someone else's wishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}え→叶う：05303_kanau⟧たい。
examples.english: I want to make my dream come true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}え→叶う：05303_kanau⟧た。

{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叶|かな}える⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた。
examples.english: I have continued to work hard every day in order to fulfill my childhood dream.

notes:
{叶|かな}える means to make a wish, dream, or hope become reality through active effort or power.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧ (intransitive — to come true, to be fulfilled)

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{叶|かな}え→叶う：05303_kanau⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing process of working to fulfill something, or the completed state of having fulfilled it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叶|かな}える: to make a dream come true
- ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叶|かな}える: to grant a wish
- ⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叶|かな}える: to fulfill a desire
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叶|かな}える: to fulfill a hope

USAGE:
Very common in inspirational and motivational contexts. The subject can be the person fulfilling their own dream or someone (including a deity) granting another's wish.
